name: Rimegrass Blessing: Cold Vine
description:
Roll Phase: Roll 2 Cryo Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you use a Skill, if the opponent's active character is affected by Dendro: Draw 1 card, heal the character on your team who has taken the most DMG for 1 HP, then remove Dendro application from the opponent's active character. (Twice per Round)
